input.prompt: List every Firecrawl feature/option that costs more than 1 credit per page (or otherwise has non-1 credit rates), with exact credit costs.

toolu_015SLdyeCDzui7Npc6utm4oZ.prompt: List every Firecrawl feature/option that costs more than 1 credit per page (or otherwise has non-1 credit rates), with exact credit costs.

content.content:
**Endpoints with non-1 base rates**

| Feature | Cost |
|---|---|
| Search | 2 credits per 10 results, rounded up (11 results = 4 credits), plus scrape costs for scraped results |
| Interact (no prompt, Playwright code only) | 2 credits per browser minute |
| Interact (with prompt) | 7 credits per browser minute |
| Interact (Zero Data Retention) | +2 per browser minute (9 with prompt, 4 code-only) |
| Agent | Dynamic, usage-based (5 free daily runs) |

Interact has a one-minute minimum per session.

**Scrape options (added to the 1 credit base per page)**

| Option | Total per page |
|---|---|
| PDF parsing | +1 per PDF page (2 total) |
| JSON format (LLM extraction) | +4 (5 total) |
| Prompt injection check | +4, or 5 if the scrape fails after the check runs |
| Zero Data Retention | +1 (2 total) |
| `question` or `query` format | +4 (5 total) |
| `highlights` format | +4 (5 total) |
| `audio` format | +4 (5 total) |
| `video` format | +4 (5 total) |
| PII redaction (`redactPII`) | +4 (5 total); each extra PDF page adds +4 |
| `lockdown` (cache hit) | +4 (5 total); a cache miss bills 1 credit |
| Enhanced proxy | +0 (same as basic) |

These modifiers stack. Crawl and Search apply them to each page they scrape.

**Other cases with non-1 costs**

| Case | Cost |
|---|---|
| Threat protection scan | 2 credits per scanned URL |
| X (x.com, twitter.com) posts and profiles | 30 total (1 base + 29 Grok query); 34 with JSON format |
| LinkedIn profile or company pages (Apollo) | 30 |
| LinkedIn (Data Legion base) | 10 |
| LinkedIn (Data Legion premium) | 40 |
| LinkedIn (FullEnrich) | 5 |

The LinkedIn costs depend on which provider matches first. Provider-routed requests can't use Zero Data Retention, lockdown, or PII redaction.

content.text:
Per Firecrawl's billing docs (docs.firecrawl.dev/billing), the base rate is 1 credit per page. These cost more.

**Scrape options (added on top of the 1-credit base)**

| Option | Total per page |
|---|---|
| PDF parsing | 2 (+1 per PDF page) |
| JSON format (LLM extraction) | 5 |
| `question` / `query` format | 5 |
| `highlights`, `audio` or `video` format | 5 each |
| PII redaction (`redactPII`) | 5 (+4 for each extra PDF page) |
| `lockdown` | 5 on a cache hit; 1 on a cache miss |
| Prompt injection check | 5 (+4); 5 if the scrape fails after the check runs |
| Zero Data Retention | 2 |

These add up when combined. Crawl and Search apply them to every page they scrape.

**Endpoints with their own rates**
- **Search:** 2 credits per 10 results, rounded up, plus the scrape cost of any results it scrapes.
- **Interact:** per browser minute, with a one-minute minimum per session.
  - Code only: 2 credits.
  - With a prompt: 7 credits.
  - Zero Data Retention adds 2 per minute.
- **Agent:** usage-based, with 5 free runs a day.

**Special cases**
- **Threat protection scan:** 2 credits per URL scanned.
- **X (Twitter) posts and profiles:** 30 credits, or 34 with JSON format.
- **LinkedIn:** 5 to 40 credits, depending on which data provider matches first (30 for Apollo, 10 or 40 for Data Legion, 5 for FullEnrich).
- **Provider-routed requests:** these can't use Zero Data Retention, lockdown or PII redaction.

Enhanced proxy costs the same as basic (+0). The page was summarized by a fetch tool, so check it for exact current numbers before budgeting around them.
